name: 原生函数与日期转换（无需外部服务）

children.name: 五种函数验证
children.script: if (vars.get('day') !== '29/02/2024') throw Error('日期转换失败'); if (vars.get('requestId').length !== 16) throw Error('随机字符串长度错误'); if (vars.get('enabled') !== 'true' || vars.get('delay') !== '1') throw Error('表达式变量未传递'); const value = functions.Random('9223372036854775807', '9223372036854775807'); if (value !== '9223372036854775807') throw Error('整数精度丢失'); functions.RandomDate('', '2024-02-29', '2024-03-01', 'zh_CN', 'randomDay'); if (vars.get('randomDay') !== '2024-02-29') throw Error('随机日期错误'); log.info('用户 {}：日期 {}，请求标识 {}', ctx.userIndex, vars.get('day'), vars.get('requestId'));

post_processors.name: 结果检查
post_processors.script: functions.changeCase('passed', 'UPPER', 'status'); if (!prev.isSuccessful() || vars.get('status') !== 'PASSED') throw Error('执行失败');
